_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.dst: 唔……我大概剛好夠買一張第 {~} 級的……你站在那裡幹嘛？
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.dst: 這些人來這裡幹嘛？別跟我說你不知道 Siegfried 大賽。
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.dst: 你是「認真的」嗎？！這是上個月那場比賽之後最盛大的事了！
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.dst: 誰贏得那場大尋寶，就能跟 Siegfried 本人一起去冒險。
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.dst: 今年我覺得我甚至很有機會贏！
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.dst: 啊？噢，你想要這張票？想都別想，這張是我的。去那間小店自己買一張。
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.dst: 那我現在要怎麼贏得一場冒險？
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#012.dst: 到 {p} 中心 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 取得 Siegfried 尋寶大賽的門票

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.dst: 賣票囉！你！要不要參加盛大的 Siegfried 尋寶大賽？
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.dst: 報名完全免費，而且你要是贏了，就能跟 Siegfried 本人一起去冒險！
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.dst: 你有興趣？太好了！來，規則很簡單。
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.dst: 票上會寫你要找哪些東西。總共分成三個級別。
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.dst: 前兩級是給一般人玩的。但你要是「真的」想贏，就得弄到一件第 {~} 級的物品。
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.dst: 嘿，你甚至可以三件全部帶來，那基本上就穩贏了！
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.dst: 來，票拿去。帶著東西回來，我就把你列入抽選。
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#020.dst: 把三件限定的 Siegfried 收藏品全部帶到 {p} 中心 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的商人那裡

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.dst: 你回來了！讓我看看你的東西。
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.dst: 這……哇，三件都有？讓我看看這些……
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.dst: 全都是真品！你一定很有——我是說，你一定是 Siegfried 的超級粉絲！
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.dst: 好了，我把你列入抽選了。活動會在 Golden Eagle Theatre 舉行。
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.dst: 往銀行那個方向轉過去，照著指示牌走就到了。大家都到齊之後就會選出優勝者。
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.
The Hero of Gavel#027.dst: 前往 {p} 銀行後方 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Golden Eagle Theatre，等待優勝者揭曉。

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.dst: 歡迎、歡迎大家！我們只要再等幾位就可以開始了。
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.dst: 啊，來了！我想現在都準備好了。
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.dst: 歡迎各位，來到每月一度的「Siegfried 慶典尋寶大賽」！
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.dst: 今天，我們要再一次頌揚 Siegfried 的英勇事蹟！
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.dst: 在場的各位 Gavel 同胞，都遠赴各地，在整個行省蒐集稀有的物品。
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.dst: 然而，優勝者不能由我來宣布……
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#034.dst: 因為要由 Siegfried 來宣布！
The Hero of Gavel#034.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.dst: 感謝各位參加這場盛大的 Gavel 尋寶大賽！Siegfried: 本次尋寶的優勝者，將享有與我一同展開一場千載難逢、完全真實的冒險的殊榮！
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.dst: 那麼，事不宜遲: 由我來宣布優勝者！
The Hero of Gavel#044.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#047.src: I better win, I bought his mug!
The Hero of Gavel#047.dst: 我最好要贏，我可是買了他的杯子！
The Hero of Gavel#047.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#051.src: {u}, please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.dst: {u}，請前往我右手邊的後台區，準備展開你的冒險。謝謝大家！！
The Hero of Gavel#051.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#052.src: Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!
The Hero of Gavel#052.dst: 到 Golden Eagle Theatre 的後台與 Siegfried 會合，展開你的冒險！

The Hero of Gavel#053.src: Welcome {u}! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#053.dst: 歡迎 {u}！恭喜你贏得尋寶大賽！
The Hero of Gavel#053.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#054.src: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.dst: 今天，你將與我一同踏上一場輝煌的冒險。
The Hero of Gavel#054.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#055.src: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
The Hero of Gavel#055.dst: 要抵達那裡，我們得搭乘偉大的 Siegfried 飛船！
The Hero of Gavel#055.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#056.src: It's up at the airship docks - I'll teleport us there!
The Hero of Gavel#056.dst: 它就停在飛船碼頭——我來把我們傳送過去！
The Hero of Gavel#056.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#057.dst: 魔法魔魔法法魔法咒語，傳送！
The Hero of Gavel#057.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#059.src: Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the {p} airship docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#059.dst: 與 Siegfried 一同從 {p} 飛船碼頭 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 搭乘他的飛船出發

The Hero of Gavel#060.src: Here, follow me onto the airship!
The Hero of Gavel#060.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#062.src: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.dst: 被我的駕駛技術折服了嗎？閃避這些島嶼對偉大的 Siegfried 來說根本不算挑戰！
The Hero of Gavel#062.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#063.src: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved {p} from the dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.dst: 當年我從那條龍手中拯救 {p} 的時候，搭的飛船就跟這艘差不多。
The Hero of Gavel#063.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#064.src: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
The Hero of Gavel#064.dst: 我們現在正前往這個區域最東邊的一座洞穴。
The Hero of Gavel#064.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#065.src: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
The Hero of Gavel#065.dst: 我們必須穿越它險惡的通道、擊敗可怕的野獸，才能拿到盡頭的寶藏。
The Hero of Gavel#065.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#066.src: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.dst: 不如你去飛船上層把我的地圖拿來，我們好準備出發冒險。
The Hero of Gavel#066.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#067.src: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map! Thanks.
The Hero of Gavel#067.dst: 還要多——噢，你把地圖拿來了！謝了。
The Hero of Gavel#067.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#068.src: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
The Hero of Gavel#068.dst: 我們得靠這張地圖，才能在那座危險的洞穴裡找路。
The Hero of Gavel#068.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#069.src: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.dst: 我怎麼弄到的？這個嘛——呃——我每次冒險前都會做好準備的！
The Hero of Gavel#069.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#070.src: Anyway, we're about to land now - be careful not to fall off!
The Hero of Gavel#070.dst: 總之，我們馬上就要降落了——小心別掉下去！
The Hero of Gavel#070.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#071.src: Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of {p} with Siegfried at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#071.dst: 與 Siegfried 一同進入 {p} 東緣 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的險惡洞穴

The Hero of Gavel#072.src: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
The Hero of Gavel#072.dst: 我們到了，這就是偉大的「囤積寶藏的邪惡生物之洞」！
The Hero of Gavel#072.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#073.src: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.dst: 等你為這場危險的冒險完全準備好了，再來跟我說。
The Hero of Gavel#073.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#074.src: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.dst: 這座洞穴極度危險，所以務必照著我的指示走。
The Hero of Gavel#074.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#075.src: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
The Hero of Gavel#075.dst: 我在這類洞穴裡英勇冒險已經有數十年經驗，我知道自己在做什麼。
The Hero of Gavel#075.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#077.src: Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#077.dst: 跟著 Siegfried 穿越 {p} 東緣 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的洞穴

The Hero of Gavel#078.src: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
The Hero of Gavel#078.dst: 你可真是慢慢來啊！沒關係。
The Hero of Gavel#078.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#079.src: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
The Hero of Gavel#079.dst: 我經常在這樣的洞穴裡冒險，好清掉住在裡頭的邪惡野獸。
The Hero of Gavel#079.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#080.src: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
The Hero of Gavel#080.dst: 要不是我在他們還來得及——
The Hero of Gavel#080.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#081.src: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
The Hero of Gavel#081.dst: 哇，停下！這看起來像是無害的裝飾，其實是陷阱！
The Hero of Gavel#081.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#082.src: Stay behind me, I'll open it with my magical spell. open!
The Hero of Gavel#082.dst: 站在我後面，我用魔法咒語打開它。開啟！
The Hero of Gavel#082.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#083.src: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.dst: 啊哈！守衛交給我，老鼠交給你！
The Hero of Gavel#083.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#085.src: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.dst: 痛——我是說，哈！這對偉大的 Siegfried 來說比拍死一隻蒼蠅還簡單！
The Hero of Gavel#085.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#086.src: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
The Hero of Gavel#086.dst: 看來這邊解決了！那對你來說一定是一場非常艱難的戰鬥。
The Hero of Gavel#086.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#087.src: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
The Hero of Gavel#087.dst: 我冒險過的那些洞穴裡，滿滿都是跟他們類似的恐怖野獸。
The Hero of Gavel#087.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#088.src: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
The Hero of Gavel#088.dst: 等等！別動，那塊巨石就要掉下來了！
The Hero of Gavel#088.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#089.src: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
The Hero of Gavel#089.dst: 哇，好險！當然，我早就料到了，一點風險也沒有。
The Hero of Gavel#089.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#090.src: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
The Hero of Gavel#090.dst: 你也許會說我們沒辦法再往前了，因為它擋住了路。但那個我可以解決！
The Hero of Gavel#090.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#091.src: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
The Hero of Gavel#091.dst: 巨石不見了！只有像我這麼強大的人才做得到。
The Hero of Gavel#091.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#092.src: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.dst: 現在我們只要跨過 Endless Chasm 上那座險惡的橋就行了。
The Hero of Gavel#092.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#093.src: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
The Hero of Gavel#093.dst: 啊，為什麼會——哇，小心！橋好像塌了。
The Hero of Gavel#093.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#094.src: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
The Hero of Gavel#094.dst: 不過這算不上你想像中的那種阻礙，因為我可以，呃，跳過這道深淵！
The Hero of Gavel#094.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#098.dst: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
The Hero of Gavel#098.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#099.src: Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#099.dst: 跟著 Siegfried 跳進洞穴盡頭的坑裡。

The Hero of Gavel#100.src: Find a way to wake Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#100.dst: 想辦法把 Siegfried 弄醒。

The Hero of Gavel#102.src: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
The Hero of Gavel#102.dst: 啊啊啊啊我的腿我的腿啊啊啊好冷！
The Hero of Gavel#102.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#104.src: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.dst: 我簽那份「蠢合約」的時候怎麼就不會「想一想」，會落到這種地步！？
The Hero of Gavel#104.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#106.src: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
The Hero of Gavel#106.dst: 他們不會來救我們的。我們只能靠自己。
The Hero of Gavel#106.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#107.src: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.dst: 你怎麼這麼冷靜？你「看不出來」嗎？！
The Hero of Gavel#107.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#108.src: WE'RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after 'dying', no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried! If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
The Hero of Gavel#108.dst: 我們只能靠自己！這次是「真的」！沒有「死掉」之後再回來這回事，沒有一眼就看得出來的陷阱，沒有 Siegfried！我要是死在這裡，就是真的死了！回不來了！
The Hero of Gavel#108.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#109.src: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
The Hero of Gavel#109.dst: 我……我做不到。我們只會餓死在這裡，在這個洞穴裡……沒有人會找到我們的屍體。
The Hero of Gavel#109.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#110.src: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.
The Hero of Gavel#110.dst: 別再看著我了！你自己想辦法把我們弄出去，我只是個沒用的演員！你找到什麼再跟我說，我、我需要獨處一下。
The Hero of Gavel#110.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#111.src: You found something? Ok, I'll.. follow you then.
The Hero of Gavel#111.dst: 你找到東西了？好。那我……那我跟著你走。
The Hero of Gavel#111.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#112.src: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
The Hero of Gavel#112.dst: 那是什麼聲音？！你、你確定我們該進去那裡嗎？
The Hero of Gavel#112.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#113.src: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
The Hero of Gavel#113.dst: 我的手臂！打到我的手臂了！
The Hero of Gavel#113.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#114.src: … I think I can manage.. OW!
The Hero of Gavel#114.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#115.src: Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#115.dst: 與 Siegfried 一同深入洞穴。

The Hero of Gavel#116.src: You.. You got us out of there!
The Hero of Gavel#116.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#117.src: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
The Hero of Gavel#117.dst: 我還以為我們永遠出不了那裡……
The Hero of Gavel#117.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#118.src: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
The Hero of Gavel#118.dst: ……好吧，我想我們該繼續走。說、說不定有出路？
The Hero of Gavel#118.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#119.src: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
The Hero of Gavel#119.dst: 你、你看！前面有植物，還有光！有出路！
The Hero of Gavel#119.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#122.src: Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.
The Hero of Gavel#122.dst: 把 Siegfried 從陷阱裡救出來，或是把他留在那裡。

The Hero of Gavel#123.src: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
The Hero of Gavel#123.dst: 剛、剛剛是怎樣？！我被困在這裡了！
The Hero of Gavel#123.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#124.src: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.dst: 這是……某種陷阱。我感覺得到地面在發燙！！
The Hero of Gavel#124.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#125.src: T-that was terrifying... Y-you saved my life. Thank you, {u}... I wasn't prepared for real danger like this.
The Hero of Gavel#125.dst: 那、那太可怕了……你、你救了我一命。謝謝你，{u}……我沒有準備好面對這種真正的危險。
The Hero of Gavel#125.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#126.src: Rest before continuing through the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#126.dst: 在繼續深入洞穴之前先休息。

The Hero of Gavel#127.src: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
The Hero of Gavel#127.dst: ……什麼？房子，還有一口井？在這麼深的地底下？
The Hero of Gavel#127.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#128.src: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
The Hero of Gavel#128.dst: 這裡……是空的。而且那些房子看起來已經好幾個世紀沒人住過了。
The Hero of Gavel#128.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#129.src: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
The Hero of Gavel#129.dst: 痛！我的腿！還有我的手臂！全、全身都好痛……我需要坐下來。我想我的手臂扭到反方向了。
The Hero of Gavel#129.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#130.src: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
The Hero of Gavel#130.dst: 我就……在這裡休息一下。你、你介意到附近看看有沒有什麼能吃的嗎？我……幾乎動不了。
The Hero of Gavel#130.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#131.src: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
The Hero of Gavel#131.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#132.src: It barely has any resemblance to one.
The Hero of Gavel#132.dst: 它跟三明治幾乎沒有任何相似之處。
The Hero of Gavel#132.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#133.src: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
The Hero of Gavel#133.dst: 唉……我想這附近也找不到更好的了。我、我吃就是了。
The Hero of Gavel#133.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#134.src: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
The Hero of Gavel#134.dst: 痛！！我想我的牙斷了！這根本是在吃石頭！
The Hero of Gavel#134.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#135.src: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
The Hero of Gavel#135.dst: ……我想——痛——我準備好——痛——可以走了。我們——嘶——出發吧。
The Hero of Gavel#135.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#136.src: ... Is this the food you found?
The Hero of Gavel#136.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#137.src: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
The Hero of Gavel#137.dst: 我想這……大概是這裡能找到最好的了。你說這是你自己煮的？
The Hero of Gavel#137.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#138.src: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
The Hero of Gavel#138.dst: 那我試試看吧。反正這附近也不會有更好的了。
The Hero of Gavel#138.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#140.src: Thank you, {u}! I feel much better. I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#140.dst: 謝謝你，{u}！我覺得好多了。你準備好了我隨時可以繼續往下走。
The Hero of Gavel#140.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#142.src: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
The Hero of Gavel#142.dst: 我想……如果這是唯一的食物，那我就吃吧。
The Hero of Gavel#142.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#143.src: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
The Hero of Gavel#143.dst: 我看看……這種東西到底要怎麼吃？
The Hero of Gavel#143.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#146.src: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.dst: 跟你說……我的本名其實叫 Gurix。
The Hero of Gavel#146.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#147.src: Sounds extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.dst: 我知道，聽起來超有 Corkian 味的。他們要我用 Siegfried，我想大概是因為聽起來沒那麼外地吧。
The Hero of Gavel#147.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#149.src: OW! {u}, I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
The Hero of Gavel#149.dst: 痛！{u}，我想這蛛網有毒！快，用你的咒語把我弄出來！
The Hero of Gavel#149.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#150.src: Thank you, {u}. I'll.. I'll follow you from now on. Clearly you're more prepared than I am.
The Hero of Gavel#150.dst: 謝謝你，{u}。我……我從現在起跟著你走。你顯然比我準備得充分多了。
The Hero of Gavel#150.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#151.src: Find your way through the spider burrows.
The Hero of Gavel#151.dst: 在蜘蛛巢穴中找出前進的路。

The Hero of Gavel#152.src: {u}? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
The Hero of Gavel#152.dst: {u}？我想那邊那張巨大的蛛網，是靠牆上那些平台撐著的。
The Hero of Gavel#152.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#153.src: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
The Hero of Gavel#153.dst: 我想……也許你可以把它們砍下來？我留在這裡，我覺得這裡最安全。要是又有蜘蛛把我黏住，我會叫你。
The Hero of Gavel#153.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#154.src: You did it! The web fell!
The Hero of Gavel#154.dst: 你成功了！蛛網掉下來了！
The Hero of Gavel#154.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#155.src: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
The Hero of Gavel#155.dst: 我們繼續走吧，我不想再碰到任何蜘蛛了。
The Hero of Gavel#155.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#157.src: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
The Hero of Gavel#157.dst: 嘿，等等我！謝謝你剛剛救了我。
The Hero of Gavel#157.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#158.src: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
The Hero of Gavel#158.dst: 哇……這裡好大！誰知道這裡以前是什麼？
The Hero of Gavel#158.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#159.src: The path seems to be across those yellow shards, maybe we can cross them?
The Hero of Gavel#159.dst: 路好像是在那些黃色碎片的另一邊，也許我們過得去？
The Hero of Gavel#159.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#160.src: Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#160.dst: 想辦法從洞穴盡頭的天窗逃出去。

The Hero of Gavel#161.src: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
The Hero of Gavel#161.dst: 又一個城鎮？還是同一個城鎮的另一區？我不確定……
The Hero of Gavel#161.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#162.src: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
The Hero of Gavel#162.dst: 這一區甚至有鍛造場和裁縫舖……這曾經是個完整、像樣的村莊！
The Hero of Gavel#162.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#164.src: {u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
The Hero of Gavel#164.dst: {u}，你看！我從這裡看得到天空！說、說不定有辦法上去！
The Hero of Gavel#164.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#165.src: I think.. what if we can this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
The Hero of Gavel#165.dst: 我在想……我們有沒有辦法讓這座間歇泉噴發？它看起來是休眠的，但我覺得我們能讓它再次啟動。
The Hero of Gavel#165.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#166.src: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
The Hero of Gavel#166.dst: 你到處看看，我稍微休息一下。我這輩子大概沒走過這麼多路……
The Hero of Gavel#166.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#168.src: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
The Hero of Gavel#168.dst: 等、等等……我們被噴上去之後，那可是很長的一段墜落。你能不能做點安全裝備，像是降落傘，或是很軟的靴子？
The Hero of Gavel#168.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#169.src: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
The Hero of Gavel#169.dst: 你已經做好了？讓我看看。
The Hero of Gavel#169.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#170.src: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
The Hero of Gavel#170.dst: 這看起來……能用？至少聊勝於無。
The Hero of Gavel#170.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#171.src: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
The Hero of Gavel#171.dst: 大概是我們在這下面能弄到最好的了。你確定自己不需要什麼嗎？不用？好吧。
The Hero of Gavel#171.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#172.src: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.dst: 我等不及要看他們回去之後臉上的表情了。我們可是拯救了 Siegfried 這個招牌！
The Hero of Gavel#172.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#176.src: W-we made it? …, WE DID IT! WE’RE BACK! HAHAAA! I’M ALIVE!
The Hero of Gavel#176.dst: 我、我們成功了？……我們做到了！我們回來了！哈哈哈！我還活著！
The Hero of Gavel#176.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#177.src: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
The Hero of Gavel#177.dst: 你好啊！我就是 Siegfried，我剛剛才解除了這座洞穴帶來的威脅！
The Hero of Gavel#177.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#178.src: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
The Hero of Gavel#178.dst: 哈，你那套服裝真不錯！看起來跟我一模一樣！
The Hero of Gavel#178.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#180.src: Hah, don’t mind the jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
The Hero of Gavel#180.dst: 哈，別理那邊那個愛開玩笑的。不過他那套服裝確實很厲害！
The Hero of Gavel#180.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#181.src: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
The Hero of Gavel#181.dst: 這、這是怎麼回事？你不能取代我！
The Hero of Gavel#181.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#183.src: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
The Hero of Gavel#183.dst: 你看那邊！那一定是為了慶祝我的勝利而放的煙火！
The Hero of Gavel#183.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#185.src: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.dst: 總之呢！你在那座洞穴裡摔得很慘。是我親自把你揹出來的，你大概產生了不少離奇的幻覺。
The Hero of Gavel#185.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#186.src: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.dst: 雖然那是你自己的失誤，我還是會把你花在尋寶大賽上的綠寶石還給你……再多給一些當作補償。那就是……[{~} Liquified Emeralds]！
The Hero of Gavel#186.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#187.src: I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#187.dst: 我現在得回 {p} 參加慶典了。也許我們會在下一場尋寶大賽再見！
The Hero of Gavel#187.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#188.src: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
The Hero of Gavel#188.dst: 你好啊，人類！我就是 Siegfried！你一定剛好錯過了我俐落終結這座怪物洞穴的英姿！
The Hero of Gavel#188.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#191.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#191.dst: {u}，很高興看到你活著出來了。摔進那道深淵一定很不好受。
The Hero of Gavel#191.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#192.src: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#192.dst: 當然，我靠著我的咒語和對洞穴的淵博知識，輕輕鬆鬆就出來了！好了，我得走了。要是你贏了下一場尋寶大賽，說不定我們還會再見！
The Hero of Gavel#192.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#193.src: As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items, and some more as compensation.
The Hero of Gavel#193.dst: 作為你這場不幸意外的補償，Siegfried 會退還你購買尋寶大賽物品所花的綠寶石，另外再多給一些當作補償。

The Hero of Gavel#194.src: That should amount to... {~} Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried, The Hero of Gavel!
The Hero of Gavel#194.dst: 金額應該是……{~} 液態綠寶石。對於你在與 Gavel 的英雄 Siegfried 冒險期間遇到的困難，我們深感抱歉！

The Hero of Gavel#195.dst: - Sky's Kitchen: 與 Siegfried 一起下廚！
The Hero of Gavel#195.speaker: Coming Soon

The Hero of Gavel#197.src: I've been saving up for this scavenger hunt all year, there's no way I can lose!
The Hero of Gavel#197.dst: 我為了這場尋寶大賽存了一整年的錢，不可能輸的！
The Hero of Gavel#197.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#198.src: Participating in the Siegfried Scavenger Hunt? If you are, the theatre's right behind me.
The Hero of Gavel#198.dst: 要參加 Siegfried 尋寶大賽嗎？要的話，劇院就在我後面。
The Hero of Gavel#198.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#199.src: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#199.dst: 本次尋寶的優勝者，將享有與我一同展開一場千載難逢、完全真實的冒險的殊榮！
The Hero of Gavel#199.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#201.src: The map's in the upper level of the airship. Ignore anything else you find there.
The Hero of Gavel#201.dst: 地圖在飛船的上層。你在那裡看到的其他東西都別管。
The Hero of Gavel#201.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#202.src: Maybe you should get the rope too...
The Hero of Gavel#202.dst: 也許你該把繩子也帶上……

The Hero of Gavel#203.src: This rope may be useful later on...
The Hero of Gavel#203.dst: 這條繩子之後說不定用得上……

The Hero of Gavel#204.src: Hey, I told you to stay behind me! I have to enter the cave first!
The Hero of Gavel#204.dst: 喂，我說過要你待在我後面！得由我先進洞穴才行！
The Hero of Gavel#204.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#205.src: You should jump in after him.

The Hero of Gavel#206.src: [!] This quest uses particles to display some information. It is recommended to have at least some particles enabled to enhance your experience.
The Hero of Gavel#206.dst: [!] 這個任務會用粒子效果顯示部分資訊。建議至少開啟一部分粒子效果，以獲得更好的體驗。

The Hero of Gavel#207.src: He's unconscious. Perhaps there's something around here to wake him up?
The Hero of Gavel#207.dst: 他昏過去了。這附近說不定有什麼東西能把他弄醒？

The Hero of Gavel#208.dst: 這應該能把 Siegfried 弄醒。

The Hero of Gavel#209.src: This boulder is stopping the portcullis chains... You'd need a pickaxe to break it, however.
The Hero of Gavel#209.dst: 這塊巨石卡住了鐵閘門的鎖鏈……不過要敲碎它，得有一把鎬才行。

The Hero of Gavel#210.src: It's an old mining expedition's log:
The Hero of Gavel#210.dst: 這是一支舊採礦探勘隊留下的日誌:

The Hero of Gavel#211.src: Supplies are limited, excavation yielding little success.
The Hero of Gavel#211.dst: 補給有限，挖掘幾乎毫無進展。

The Hero of Gavel#212.src: We've attempted going around the portcullis, but the beast in the only cave past it killed one of our crew.
The Hero of Gavel#212.dst: 我們試過繞過鐵閘門，但閘門後面唯一那座洞穴裡的野獸殺了我們一名隊員。

The Hero of Gavel#213.src: Apart from the portcullis, there are no signs of villagers or of the town itself. The team is beginning to doubt its existence.
The Hero of Gavel#213.dst: 除了那道鐵閘門，這裡看不到任何村民或城鎮本身的蹤跡。隊員們開始懷疑它是否真的存在。

The Hero of Gavel#214.src: The return crew is lowering the crane tomorrow, so it's unlikely we can find anything before then. Logs will be left for use of any future excavations.
The Hero of Gavel#214.dst: 回程小組明天就會把吊車降下來，在那之前恐怕找不到什麼了。日誌會留在這裡，供日後的挖掘行動使用。

The Hero of Gavel#215.src: The rest of the log lists geological information about the cave and a supply manifest.
The Hero of Gavel#215.dst: 日誌剩下的部分列的是這座洞穴的地質資料，還有一份補給清單。

The Hero of Gavel#216.src: Find a way deeper into the cave and lead Siegfried there with you.
The Hero of Gavel#216.dst: 找出通往洞穴更深處的路，並帶著 Siegfried 一起過去。

The Hero of Gavel#218.src: The cage fell! You should go help Siegfried out.
The Hero of Gavel#218.dst: 籠子掉下來了！你該去把 Siegfried 救出來。

The Hero of Gavel#219.src: Siegfried has died in the cage. You'll have to find your way out yourself.
The Hero of Gavel#219.dst: Siegfried 死在籠子裡了。你得自己找路出去。

The Hero of Gavel#220.src: It seems the trap machinery broke down!
The Hero of Gavel#220.dst: 陷阱的機關好像故障了！

The Hero of Gavel#221.src: This area seems like a good place to rest before moving on. Siegfried would have been overjoyed to see this.
The Hero of Gavel#221.dst: 這一帶看起來是繼續前進之前歇腳的好地方。Siegfried 要是看到這裡，一定會樂壞的。

The Hero of Gavel#223.src: Maybe that web would fall if you cut the ones supporting it?
The Hero of Gavel#223.dst: 如果把撐著它的那幾張蛛網割斷，那張蛛網說不定就會掉下來？

The Hero of Gavel#224.src: It looks like the way forward is across the yellow shards...
The Hero of Gavel#224.dst: 看來往前的路就在那些黃色碎片的另一邊……

The Hero of Gavel#225.src: Picking up lava with your bare hands seems like a bad idea.
The Hero of Gavel#225.dst: 徒手去撈熔岩，怎麼想都不是好主意。

The Hero of Gavel#226.src: ... Is that sunlight at the other side of the cave?

The Hero of Gavel#227.src: This is a sewing machine.. It still seems to work.
The Hero of Gavel#227.dst: 這是一台縫紉機……看起來還能用。

The Hero of Gavel#228.src: It's a tailor's notes on how to create some items:
The Hero of Gavel#228.dst: 這是一位裁縫的筆記，寫著幾樣東西的做法:

The Hero of Gavel#229.src: To Sarnim - If you really wanted to learn the craft, here's some simple items to get you started.
The Hero of Gavel#229.dst: 給 Sarnim，你要是真的想學這門手藝，這裡有幾樣簡單的東西可以讓你起步。

The Hero of Gavel#230.src: Parachute: Some cloth and rope. I haven't found any rope since the shattering, I don't think there's any in the storage either.
The Hero of Gavel#230.dst: 降落傘: 一些布和繩子。大崩裂之後我就沒再找到過繩子，我想倉庫裡也沒有。

The Hero of Gavel#231.src: Soft Boots: Cloth, and some soft slime. I usually get my slime from the spider burrows past the gate.
The Hero of Gavel#231.dst: 軟靴: 布，加上一些軟黏液。我的黏液通常是到大門後面的蜘蛛巢穴拿的。

The Hero of Gavel#232.src: Hard Boots: Cloth and leather. These hurt quite a bit, so be careful. There should be some leather in the storage if you make these.
The Hero of Gavel#232.dst: 硬靴: 布和皮革。穿起來相當痛，所以要小心。要做的話，倉庫裡應該有一些皮革。

The Hero of Gavel#233.src: It's an old notebook listing some research about geysers:
The Hero of Gavel#233.dst: 這是一本舊筆記本，記著一些關於間歇泉的研究:

The Hero of Gavel#234.src: The geyser was active back before the shattering, but it seems to have filled up.
The Hero of Gavel#234.dst: 這座間歇泉在大崩裂之前還會噴發，但現在似乎被填滿了。

The Hero of Gavel#235.src: It hasn't erupted in weeks. However! My studies on the small geysers have proven lava can activate them again!
The Hero of Gavel#235.dst: 它已經好幾個星期沒噴發了。不過！我對小型間歇泉的研究證明，熔岩可以讓它們再次噴發！

The Hero of Gavel#236.src: Hannux still refuses to give me molten metal from his forge, though. My next tests ought to convince him.
The Hero of Gavel#236.dst: 只是 Hannux 還是不肯把他鍛造場裡的熔融金屬給我。我接下來的實驗應該能說服他。

The Hero of Gavel#237.src: It's an old, tattered book labelled 'Sustainable Food in the Caverns, by Hannux and Ilorav'
The Hero of Gavel#237.dst: 這是一本又舊又破的書，封面寫著「洞窟裡的永續糧食，Hannux 與 Ilorav 合著」

The Hero of Gavel#238.src: This document should outline a sustainable method for the continued survival of our town for however long we may be in these caverns.
The Hero of Gavel#238.dst: 本文件旨在概述一套可長可久的方法，無論我們要在這些洞窟裡待多久，都能讓我們的城鎮繼續存活下去。

The Hero of Gavel#239.src: Multiple varieties of mushrooms have grown in the years after the shattering. These are edible and a primary source of food.
The Hero of Gavel#239.dst: 大崩裂之後的這些年裡，長出了好幾種蘑菇。它們可以食用，是主要的糧食來源。

The Hero of Gavel#240.src: A bioluminescent material allows for trees and grass to grow, albeit very slowly.
The Hero of Gavel#240.dst: 有一種生物發光物質讓樹木與草得以生長，只是速度非常緩慢。

The Hero of Gavel#241.src: We recommend taking good care of the trees, grass, and bushes - they may become a valuable source of food in the future.
The Hero of Gavel#241.dst: 我們建議好好照料樹木、草和灌木，它們日後可能成為寶貴的糧食來源。

The Hero of Gavel#242.src: We have also found that there is very little edible plant life outside of our section of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#242.dst: 我們還發現，在我們這一區洞窟以外，可食用的植物非常稀少。

The Hero of Gavel#243.src: A smaller group was far less lucky than us and ended up in an area with virtually no edible material - we found the remains of their homes in a recent expedition.
The Hero of Gavel#243.dst: 有一小群人遠不如我們幸運，落腳在一個幾乎沒有東西可吃的地方。我們在最近一次探勘中發現了他們住處的遺跡。

The Hero of Gavel#244.src: A species of spiders and creeping mold has appeared as well. These are not suitable for consumption, and should be left alone. They are peaceful unless attacked.
The Hero of Gavel#244.dst: 另外還出現了一種蜘蛛和一種會蔓延的黴菌。這些都不適合食用，不要去招惹。只要不受攻擊，他們並不會傷人。

The Hero of Gavel#245.src: The rest of the book seems to be repeating the same information but in extreme detail.
The Hero of Gavel#245.dst: 這本書剩下的部分似乎都在重複同樣的資訊，只是寫得極其詳盡。

The Hero of Gavel#249.src: Tickets for sale! Get your Siegfried Scavenger Hunt tickets here!
The Hero of Gavel#249.dst: 賣票囉！Siegfried 尋寶大賽的門票這裡買！
The Hero of Gavel#249.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#250.src: You sense you're going back the way you came...
The Hero of Gavel#250.dst: 你感覺自己正在往回走……

The Hero of Gavel#251.src: You'd need an explosive to disable this. There don't seem to be any in here, however.
The Hero of Gavel#251.dst: 要拆掉這個得用炸藥。不過這裡頭似乎一個也沒有。

The Hero of Gavel#252.src: You get a sense you're going backwards...

The Hero of Gavel#253.src: There's some small caves around here.. Maybe there'll be something edible there?
The Hero of Gavel#253.dst: 這附近有些小洞穴……說不定那裡會有能吃的東西？
The Hero of Gavel#253.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#254.src: I don't... feel too good. I think.. I can move on though, as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#254.dst: 我……覺得不太舒服。我想……不過你準備好的話，我還是能繼續走。
The Hero of Gavel#254.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#255.src: This oven still seems to be in working order.

The Hero of Gavel#256.src: Those lines of silk from the big web are holding it up. If you cut all three, it might break.
The Hero of Gavel#256.dst: 撐住它的是大蛛網上那幾條絲線。如果你把三條都割斷，它說不定就會斷掉。
The Hero of Gavel#256.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#257.src: You get a sense you're going the wrong way...

The Hero of Gavel#258.src: Good thing we got past that chasm! Let's keep going!
The Hero of Gavel#258.dst: 還好我們過了那道深淵！繼續走吧！
The Hero of Gavel#258.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#259.src: .. {u}... are you sure those u-uncooked eggs were.. safe?
The Hero of Gavel#259.dst: ……{u}……你確定那些生、生的蛋……安全嗎？
The Hero of Gavel#259.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#260.src: Ugh.. I don't feel.. very good..
The Hero of Gavel#260.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#261.src: I can feel.. something.. ins--- AAAAAAARHGH!
The Hero of Gavel#261.dst: 我感覺得到……有東西……在裡——啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
The Hero of Gavel#261.speaker: Gurix
